_readme: DS18B20 sensors on the PAT boards (ROM id -> name, group top/bottom, offset_C added to the reading). Used by pat_temp_logger.py and pat_temp_app.py. Add the bottom sensor after it is connected (its id is printed by: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe .\pat_temp_logger.py --once).

28FD50D8000000AE.name: top_pat
28FD50D8000000AE.note: top PAT board (identified by the user on 2026-10-15, first sensor connected)

2821CCD600000094.name: bottom_pat
2821CCD600000094.note: bottom PAT board (the second sensor connected on 2026-10-15)
